The Chinese characters for Walter

As a transliteration, Walter is usually written 沃尔特 (Wò ěr tè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

沃
Wò
fertile, irrigate
尔
ěr
you, thus
特
tè
special

Origin and meaning

With Germanic origins, Walter is usually read as “army ruler”.

About the name Walter

The name of the writer Sir Walter Scott.
